title: Recovery draft reaction lines
description: LF-070: lines that react to the between-anchor recovery draft (scripts/draft.gd), which is not scoped to any one anchor the way data/dialog/anchor-NN.json is. dialog.schema.json's `anchor` field is a real anchor id the validator cross-references against data/anchors/ (validate_data.py's check_dialog), which has no meaning here — the draft screen shows the same reaction regardless of which anchor was just cleared. This schema exists so that stays true without stretching the per-anchor one to mean something it does not.
